clips.title: 英伟达请回黄仁勋：CFRA称董事会别无选择，董事会真被逼到墙角？

subtitles.en: Angela Zino of CFRA now has a by rating on this stock.
subtitles.zh: CFRA的Angela Zino目前对该股给出买入评级。

subtitles.en: He writes the following, we believe it's a game changer. We acknowledge risks and noise given pending investigations.
subtitles.zh: 她写道，我们认为这将改变游戏规则。鉴于正在进行的调查，我们承认存在风险和噪音。

subtitles.en: We think Jensen will most likely be protected, assuming no national security breaches.
subtitles.zh: 我们认为，假设没有国家安全漏洞，Jensen很可能受到保护。

subtitles.en: Angela, join us now for more. Angela, welcome to the show. What kind of guarantees do you think this board got over the weekend?
subtitles.zh: Angela，现在加入我们了解更多。Angela，欢迎来到节目。你认为董事会这个周末得到了什么样的保证？

subtitles.en: I mean, I think they had no choice, but to bring Jensen back.
subtitles.zh: 我认为他们别无选择，只能让Jensen回来。

subtitles.en: And I think they heard whatever they needed to hear from the administration.
subtitles.zh: 我认为他们从政府那里听到了他们需要听到的一切。

subtitles.en: It was, I think, almost kind of an ultimatum in the sense of you better bring them back.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这几乎是一种最后通牒，意思是你最好让他们回来。

subtitles.en: Or we're going to have issues here. I mean, clearly what we've seen in terms of developments over the last two weeks, and just listening to the earnings call last week,
subtitles.zh: 否则我们这里就会有问题。我的意思是，显然从过去两周的发展来看，以及上周听财报电话会议，

subtitles.en: I mean, Jensen is in video in many respects, right?
subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，Jensen在很多方面就是英伟达的代表，对吧？

subtitles.en: And when you start thinking about how important he is, again, not only to Nvidia, but also to the U.S. economy, and to some extent, the global economy,
subtitles.zh: 当你开始思考他有多重要时，再次强调，不仅对英伟达，也对美国经济，并在某种程度上对全球经济，

subtitles.en: and this whole AI infrastructure build out, he's absolutely a critical component of everything at this point in time.
subtitles.zh: 而在整个人工智能基础设施建设中，他目前绝对是关键一环。

subtitles.en: And likely, at least until we find some succession plan and kind of get a couple of years further down the road in terms of this AI build out,
subtitles.zh: 而且很可能，至少在我们找到某种继任计划、并且在人工智能建设方面再推进几年之前，

subtitles.en: he's going to be needed out there. Angela, what kind of shakeup on Nvidia's board are you expecting after this?
subtitles.zh: 他仍将是不可或缺的。安吉拉，在此之后你预计英伟达董事会会有怎样的调整？

subtitles.en: Hard to tell, I mean, something's got to be done. I would say at this point in time, there's got to be some sort.
subtitles.zh: 很难说，我的意思是，总得做点什么。我认为在现阶段，必须进行某种调整。

clip_research.source_claim: CFRA's Zino says the Nvidia board had no choice but to bring Jensen Huang back, and that they heard what they needed from the administration, almost like an ultimatum.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public reporting confirms Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and board member effective immediately, while internal and California/federal investigations continued.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The board publicly framed the reinstatement as its own unanimous decision after discussions with Huang; the analyst characterizes it as effectively forced by the administration, which is a stronger causal claim than the official statement.

evidence.fact: Zino: 'I think they had no choice, but to bring Jensen back' and 'almost kind of an ultimatum'.
